chapter: Interferometry, quantum optics and photon statistics

variants.title: Heralded photons at low pump power
variants.sample: Heralded source, pump power low: 0.5 % of heralds hold two photons
variants.note: The chance of a second pair rises with pump power. At a quarter of the base pump the double-pair fraction is 0.5 % and alpha is about 0.01.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet

variants.title: Heralded photons at high pump power
variants.sample: Heralded source, pump power high: 5 % of heralds hold two photons
variants.note: Doubling and a half the base pump raises the double-pair fraction to 5 %: alpha climbs towards 0.1, still below 1.
